rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: PageLens AI runs automated website audits covering security, SEO, performance, UX, and accessibility, returning findings with actionable fixes. The MCP server exposes six read-only tools and one write tool for querying scan results, retrieving findings, and submitting agent feedback for human review. Authentication uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and short-lived access tokens.
